email1.subject: A simple Google Analytics alternative without cookies
email1.preview: Discover Plausible Analytics, trusted by 22,000 paying customers.
email1.body:
Google Analytics can be overkill, frustrating to use, and privacy-invasive. Plausible Analytics is a simple, lightweight, and privacy-friendly alternative.

Plausible gives you clear, useful insights on a single page without complexity or training. Our script is 54 times smaller than Google Analytics, saving 135KB of JavaScript per visitor to keep your site fast.

Best of all, Plausible does not collect personal data or track individual users. That means no cookies and no need for cookie banners or GDPR consent banners.

Plausible is made and hosted in the EU, powered by European-owned infrastructure. Over 22,000 paying subscribers and organizations like Stripe, Mozilla, MongoDB, Harvard University, and Sentry trust us with their data.

Start your 30-day free trial today with no credit card required.

The Plausible team

email2.subject: Will Plausible give you the depth and speed you need
email2.preview: See how Plausible handles traffic sources, funnels, and uptime.
email2.body:
Switching your web analytics might raise questions about data depth and reliability. Plausible stores over 332 billion events and maintains a 99.99% uptime over the last 90 days.

You do not lose out on advanced reporting. Plausible includes automatic scroll depth tracking, AI tool traffic monitoring for ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude, Search Console integration, and UTM campaign tracking.

You can track file downloads, form completions, external link clicks, and revenue without code. Measure drop-off across a fixed sequence of steps with funnels and user journeys, and filter out bots and referrer spam automatically out of the box.

Paid plans start at $9 per month with two months free on yearly billing.

The Plausible team

email3.subject: Start your 30-day free trial of Plausible
email3.preview: Try Plausible today with no credit card required.
email3.body:
It is time to ditch Google Analytics for a tool that respects visitor privacy and gives you clear insights in one minute.
